name: Flavor of Spring
desc: Zibai's specialty. Its color gleams like golden amber, reminiscent of her eyes. Its aroma is as familiar as a simple spring roll, yet each crisp bite reveals an unexpected resilience... Could this be a secret recipe from ancient Lang-Gan?

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 282 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
